description: This Java source file defines the 'AccountingRule' class, which models accounting rules within the Fineract accounting module. It includes properties, relationships, and methods for creating, updating, and managing accounting rules and their associated tags.

classes.name: AccountingRule
classes.description: Represents an accounting rule with properties for accounts, description, tags, and configuration flags, including methods for creation, updates, and tag management.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AccountingRule instance from JSON input, associating it with specified accounts and office, and setting configuration flags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of the AccountingRule based on JSON command input, tracking changes.

methods.name: handlePropertyUpdate
methods.description: Helper methods to handle updates for string, boolean, and long property types based on JSON command input.

methods.name: updateAccountingRuleForTags
methods.description: Associates a list of AccountingTagRule objects with this AccountingRule.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Filters and retains tags based on the journal entry type (credit or debit).

methods.name: getAccountingTagRulesByType
methods.description: Retrieves tags matching a specific journal entry type.

methods.name: removeOldTags
methods.description: Removes specified tags from the AccountingRule.
